question: The polity of a country is designed according to its ______ and any change to the polity is possible only when an amendment is made.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Constitution.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The polity of a country is designed according to its **Constitution**__ and any change to the polity is possible only when an amendment is made.
 
• The Indian Constitution can be amended to meet the **changing demands of the country.**
 
• A constitution that can be very easily changed or amended is often called **flexible.**
 
• A constitution that is very difficult to amend is described as** rigid.**
 
• The Indian Constitution** combines both flexible and rigid characteristics.**
 
• When an amendment seeks to change an article relating to the** allocation of powers between the states and the federal government**, or an article relating to the representation, the States must be contacted and consented to.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• During its 74-year existence, the Soviet Union had four constitutions (**1918, 1924, 1936, and 1977**).
 
• The Communist Party of the Soviet Union's control ended in 1991, and the Soviet Union rapidly collapsed.
 
• In 1993, the newly formed Russian Federation adopted a new constitution as a result of this political upheaval.
